title: 第9章 杂役不用脑一辈子受欺负第10章 我看你是神志不清了
content_zh:
林陌本想去找柳紫嫣出面，但仔细想想，又不太可能。
柳紫嫣可能会出面帮他解决，但让柳紫嫣出面不太可能。
“说不定，柳紫嫣那女魔头就在紫天宫里看着呢...”
刚才的事，基本上可以算是发生在柳紫嫣的眼皮子底下了。
但直到现在，她也没有任何的反应。
那就说明，柳紫嫣并不想管此事。
或者说，她想看林陌自己要如何处理眼下的困局。
当不当紫天宫的这个御用杂役，林陌是没多大所谓的。
现在问题的关键是，一旦他回到杂役部，那指定没他好果子吃。
“他娘的，老夫现在要是筑基期，就不用这么麻烦了。”
杂役部本质上就是一群废柴聚集地，但凡有点修炼资质的，谁会被分配来杂役部当杂役弟子？
即便是杂役部的管事，也不过堪堪筑基初期修为。
刚才那位赵东海，杂役部往生堂的主管，也仅仅只是炼气七重。
但他们对于现在的林陌来说，仍然是不可匹敌之敌。
“是了！”
下一息，林陌豁然开朗：“杂役不用脑，活该一辈子受欺负！”
以他现在的修为，在杂役部管事手下，肯定是挣扎不了的。
但这并不代表，林陌就是砧板上的鱼肉，任人宰割了。
他现在最大的优势就是，在掌门柳紫嫣手底下做事，其次便是资历！
在初圣宗百余年，更深的秘密他不敢说。

至少杂役部的那些见不得光的琐事，林陌是心知肚明的。
于是，林陌立即回屋，取来纸和笔，开始奋笔疾书。
约莫两个时辰之后，一封举报信便落成了。
出了木屋，看着紫天宫的大门，林陌却是犯难了。
现在最大的问题是，要如何把举报信送到柳紫嫣手里。
不需要打杂的时候，按照规矩，身为杂役的林陌是不被允许随意进出紫天宫的。
“林老头，一阵子不见，你看上去好像精神了不少呢。”
瞌睡了来枕头。
就在林陌一筹莫展之际，一道青白相间的倩影，带着一股沁人心脾的芬芳，朝着紫天宫而来。
那是一名约莫十八岁左右的少女，略显稚嫩的绝美俏脸，噙着一抹天真烂漫的微笑。
浓密的三千青丝，系成一条马尾辫，高高翘起。
content_en:
Lin Mo originally wanted to find Liu Ziyan to come forward, but thinking about it carefully, it was impossible.
Liu Ziyan may come forward to help him solve it, but it is unlikely that Liu Ziyan will come forward.
"Maybe Liu Ziyan, the female devil, is watching from Zitian Palace..."
What just happened basically happened under Liu Ziyan's nose.
But until now, she had no reaction.
That shows that Liu Ziyan doesn't want to take care of this matter.
In other words, she wanted to see how Lin Mo would deal with the current predicament.
Lin Mo didn't care much whether he should be the royal servant of Zitian Palace.
The key to the problem now is that once he returns to the handyman department, there will definitely be no good things for him.
"Damn it, if I were in the foundation building stage now, I wouldn't have to go to such trouble."
The Miscellaneous Service Department is essentially a gathering place for a bunch of losers. Whoever has some cultivation qualifications will be assigned to the Miscellaneous Service Department as a handyman disciple?
Even the stewards of the Miscellaneous Department are only in the early stages of foundation building.
That Zhao Donghai just now, the director of the Rebirth Hall of the Miscellaneous Department, was only at the seventh level of Qi Refining.
But they are still invincible enemies to Lin Mo now.
"Yes!"
The next breath, Lin Mo suddenly understood: "The handyman doesn't have any brains and deserves to be bullied for the rest of his life!"
With his current level of cultivation, he would definitely not be able to struggle under the stewards of the Miscellaneous Department.
But this does not mean that Lin Mo is just a piece of fish on the chopping board, ready to be slaughtered by others.
His biggest advantage now is that he works under the leader Liu Ziyan, and the second is his seniority!
In the Chu Sheng Sect for more than a hundred years, he did not dare to tell the deeper secrets.
At least Lin Mo was well aware of the shady trivial matters in the handyman department.
So, Lin Mo immediately went back to the house, got some paper and pen, and started writing furiously.
About two hours later, a reporting letter was completed.
After leaving the wooden house and looking at the gate of Zitian Palace, Lin Mo was in trouble.
The biggest problem now is how to deliver the report letter to Liu Ziyan.
When there is no need to do odd jobs, according to the rules, Lin Mo, as a handyman, is not allowed to enter and exit Zitian Palace at will.
"Old man Lin, I haven't seen you for a while. You seem to be in a lot of energy."
I fell asleep and took a pillow.
Just when Lin Mo was at his wits' end, a green and white silhouette, carrying a refreshing fragrance, came towards Zitian Palace.
It was a girl of about eighteen years old, with a beautiful and childish face, and an innocent smile.
Thick three thousand blue hairs are tied into a ponytail and raised high.
